def state(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in('R','b','N') and n['pixels']==16 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<50:
            d[n['color']]=[min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==4 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<50:
            d['tip']=[min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])]
    return d
